title: Restore the release command runner after a dependency update
prompt: The release command runner stopped working after its dependency update. Fix src/ so the existing API and README behavior work again, including lifecycle callbacks and failed-command results. Keep the installed dependency versions and tests unchanged. Use the visible test command while working.
notes_private: Reference uses parseCommandString plus execa, and accesses lifecycle events via nodeChildProcess. Execa 10 executes normally under Bun 1.4.3. Hidden checks include multiple separator spaces, backslash-escaped spaces and exit 7 with stderr.
